source.page_mapping: Source old21..54 are current LP2-04..37. Pinned source rune streams were individually checked nonempty and byte-for-byte in GP29 indices against current site text. The archived scripts' relocated relative page paths do not resolve; their source output is not treated as a negative result.

prior_work.lookup: research/prior_work.py was queried for both exact source paths and autokey-feedback terms; no exact source-path record was returned.
prior_work.overlap: public-multihistory-feedback tests all-equal seeds with different scoring and wider operators; feedback-opening-census tests 12-rune openings rather than whole-page source gates. The P21–30 script has 17/18 keyword vectors identical to the comprehensive script on contained pages and six identical operators; only its four-rune DEOR vector differs from the comprehensive three-rune DEOR. Avoid double-counting those 17*10*6 repeated configurations.
prior_work.thematic_user_proposal: A manuscript-derived numerical autokey was supplied without an exact recurrence or shed/reset rule. This tests only the source's explicit plaintext/ciphertext feedback recurrences, not that broader idea.

test.representation: Source GP29 order and source comprehensive word parser's singleton positions, preserving page boundaries. Each source phase starts its seed at page position zero; no word reset.
test.comprehensive_phase1: All 22 literal keyword arrays * 6 modes * 34 old pages21..54, source all-singleton I/A gate then normalized GP29 IoC > 1.3 hit screen.
test.comprehensive_phase2: Every 29^2 two-rune seed * 6 modes * 34 pages, same gate/screen.
test.comprehensive_phase3: Every 29^3 three-rune seed * 6 modes * old pages21..54 with at least three source singletons; same gate/screen and same source skip on pages with fewer than three.
test.p21_distinct: Only the P21–30 script's source four-rune DEOR [23,18,3,4] on its ten pages and six modes; its IoC>1.3 screen has no singleton requirement. Its other 17 keyword arrays duplicate the comprehensive phase1 operator/page domain. Its separate Deor/Emerson running-key and double-layer branches are excluded as different methods and data dependencies.
test.selection: For each phase and the distinct P21 DEOR subgroup, report all-source setting count, singleton-compatible count, hit count, best post-gate normalized IoC, page/seed/mode, full decoded-output SHA256, and per-page counts. Preserve exact source >1.3 strict inequality and page eligibility.
test.null: Repeat each complete phase and the P21 DEOR subgroup on 49 independently seeded within-page rune shuffles; preserve page lengths and original singleton positions; seed 20261023. Compare complete-search maxima and hit counts, not a single chosen candidate. Null is a control, not a cipher model.
test.positive_control: Before LP2 outcomes, take independently recorded LP1 warning GP values, tile to old21 page length, set source singleton positions alternately to I/A, and encrypt with CABAL under each of six modes. Original extracted source functions must recover exact planted stream and pass all-singleton and IoC>1.3 gate. One changed seed must fail planted plaintext-feedback gate; ciphertext-feedback seed may still pass because its suffix is seed-independent. This is a constructed solved-reading-derived control, not an original-source LP1 validation.
test.source_parity: Compare sampled source functions and source keyword vectors with optimized engine before running. Independently verify every saved winner by scalar recurrence and recompute scores/hashes. Check exact source blobs at the pinned revision.
test.optimization: Source-equivalent affine prefix/suffix algebra may prune seeds failing singleton positions before scoring. Ciphertext-feedback suffix is computed once per page/mode/seed length; all seed-dependent prefixes are still counted exactly. Validate candidate rows and ties against direct source functions on samples; do not change scoring or skip source settings.

interpretation_limits: One source-defined key list and finite two-/three-rune seeds, selected old pages, six unreset GP29 feedback modes, source singleton/Ioc gate. A hit is not English proof. Ciphertext-feedback seed can only affect its own k-rune prefix, so long-page scores cannot identify the seed. No broad autokey or emergence hypothesis is closed.
